user.title: Set up Smart Place
user.description: Paste the long secret URL token from your Smart Place app URL. The token is everything after the `?` in `{url}`.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Smart Place
reauth_confirm.description: Your Smart Place token has been rejected. Paste a fresh token from the app URL.

error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected by Smart Place.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Smart Place server. Check connectivity and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Smart Place installation is already configured.

data_description.protected_sockets: Home Assistant sends no command for a protected socket: turning it on or off from Home Assistant does nothing. Smart Place scenes, the 'All lights' button, wall buttons and the Smart Place app can still switch it.
data_description.lower_delay_minutes: For blinds whose switch 'Lower after weather alarm' is on: how long Home Assistant waits after the end of the alarm before it lowers the blind. 0 lowers it at once. The wait ends without lowering if the alarm comes back, the blind is moved, or the connection to Smart Place is lost.

abort.not_loaded: Smart Place is not running, so its sockets are not known. Start the integration and try again.

not_connected.message: The command was not sent: there is no connection to the Smart Place server.

state_unknown.message: The command was not sent: the current state is not known yet, and Smart Place can only toggle.

no_off_level.message: This device has no off: Smart Place always keeps one level active. Choose a level instead.

adjust_setpoint.name: Adjust setpoint
adjust_setpoint.description: Moves the setpoint of a heating zone up or down along the Smart Place scale 18-26 °C, where 18 means off. The result is limited to that scale.

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: Number of whole degrees to move: positive raises, negative lowers.

get_plan_config.name: Get plan dashboard configuration
get_plan_config.description: Returns the configuration of the Smart Place dashboard (floor plan views for lights, blinds and climate, and the scenes view), for use in a dashboard of your own.

config_entry_id.name: Smart Place entry
config_entry_id.description: The Smart Place installation. Only needed when more than one is set up.
